title: LinguaLeap – Learn Languages in 10 Minutes a Day

en: LinguaLeap, developed by Nordhaven Labs GmbH, helps you learn 12 languages with short daily lessons of just 10 minutes. More than 3,500 interactive lessons, created together with linguist Clara Mendes, cover vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation.

Our speech recognition engine gives you instant feedback on your pronunciation, and offline mode lets you download up to 50 lessons for your travels. Your progress syncs automatically across all your devices.

The free version includes 5 lessons per day. LinguaLeap Premium unlocks unlimited lessons for €9.99 per month or €59.99 per year, saving you 50% compared with monthly billing. A Family plan for up to 6 members costs €89.99 per year.

New subscribers receive a 7-day free trial. Payment will be charged to your account when the trial ends, and your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Limited-time offer: subscribe to the annual plan between March 1, 2026 and March 31, 2026 and pay only €44.99 for your first year.
Version 4.2, released on February 10, 2026, adds 2 new languages and improved review exercises. If you have any questions, our support team will reply within 48 hours.

Los nuevos suscriptores disfrutan de una prueba gratuita de 7 días. El pago se cargará en tu cuenta al finalizar la prueba, y la suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo en curso.
Oferta por tiempo limitado: suscríbete al plan anual entre el 1 de marzo de 2026 y el 31 de marzo de 2026 y paga solo 44,99 € por tu primer año.

La versión 4.2, publicada el 10 de febrero de 2026, añade 2 nuevos idiomas y ejercicios de repaso mejorados. Si tienes alguna pregunta, nuestro equipo de soporte te responderá en un plazo de 48 horas.
